risks.risk: Exact model is not readable, so we can’t price accurately for the correct market value and duplex capability.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label (front/back) showing the full model number (e.g., on the rating plate) and the printer’s display showing model info if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic HP monochrome laser MFP with unknown duplex performance.

risks.risk: Seller claim of 'colour MFP' may be wrong (could be monochrome), affecting value.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner configuration/toner type (colour vs black) and/or a test print showing colour output (if claimed colour).
risks.if_unproven: Price as monochrome MFP (worst case vs claimed colour).

risks.risk: Page count under 20,000 copies can’t be verified; high usage can mean wear (fuser, rollers).
risks.proof: Photo of the printer’s usage/counter page (total pages) or a service report showing page count.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear used unit (worst case for reliability).

risks.risk: “New drum and toner just fitted” may not be genuine or may not resolve underlying issues (fuser/rollers/transfer belt).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of drum and toner part numbers/labels and a short video of printing (including duplex if available) with no errors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed—assume potential consumables/maintenance needed.

risks.risk: No paper jam claim isn’t proven; could jam under load or during duplex.
risks.proof: Video of a full print job (preferably duplex) from tray 1 to output with no jam messages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may require troubleshooting/maintenance (worst case).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model number/rating plate (front/back) so the exact HP MFP model can be identified.
Photo of the printer’s page count/usage counters screen (showing total pages).
Close-up photos of the installed toner and drum labels/part numbers (and any installation sticker).
Short video of a successful duplex print (or at least a full print run) showing no jam/error messages.
response.reason: The photo shows an HP monochrome laser MFP, but the exact model and key condition claims (page count, new drum/toner, no jams, duplex performance) are not verifiable from the single image. Without model and counter proof, pricing would be too uncertain, so request the decisive photos/videos first.
